decks.notes: The deck focuses on creating early game disruption for the opponent while developing a board presence with aggressive creatures. The hatebears like Archon of Emeria and Chancellor of the Annex slow down the opponent's game plan, while cards like Clarion Conqueror and Seasoned Dungeoneer provide a quick clock for victory. The deck also includes disruptive artifacts like Void Mirror and land destruction with Strip Mine and Wasteland to further disrupt the opponent's plans. The goal is to pressure the opponent's resources and disrupt their game plan to secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board and resources through a combination of counterspells, removal, and disruptive creatures like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade. It also utilizes various powerful cards such as Ancestral Recall, Black Lotus, and Time Walk to generate card advantage and gain tempo. The inclusion of cards like Null Rod and Orcish Bowmasters further disrupts the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent while slowly building up its own advantage to eventually secure a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures like Vengevine, Blazing Rootwalla, Hollow One, and Master of Death. This allows for aggressive plays early in the game while also having disruptive control elements like Force of Will, Force of Negation, and Mindbreak Trap to protect the game plan. Chalice of the Void and Subtlety provide additional disruption, while Squee, Goblin Nabob and Fury offer recurring threats and removal options. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of speed, efficiency, and resilience.

This deck aims to quickly combo off using Doomsday to stack their library with specific cards, then win the game by casting Thassa's Oracle to win before the opponent can react. The deck is packed with card draw, counterspells, and tutors to allow for a consistent and efficient combo. The key strategy revolves around setting up the Doomsday pile effectively to guarantee a win with Thassa's Oracle, while also defending the combo with counterspells and disruption to ensure success in a fast-paced 1 vs 1 Vintage environment.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful artifacts to disrupt opponents while deploying aggressive threats to quickly close out the game. By using cards like Wasteland, Null Rod, and Chalice of the Void, the deck aims to control the board and limit opponent's options. Additionally, the deck includes Mishra's Workshop to accelerate out threats like Golos, Tireless Pilgrim and Lodestone Golem. The combination of disruptive artifacts and aggressive creatures make it difficult for opponents to effectively respond, allowing the deck to apply pressure and secure victories in a quick and efficient manner.

The deck focuses on utilizing hatebear creatures and disruptive cards to slow down the opponent's strategy while maintaining a fast-paced aggressive game plan. By playing cards like Anointed Peacekeeper, Archon of Emeria, and Chancellor of the Annex, the deck seeks to hinder the opponent's ability to cast spells efficiently. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Void Mirror and Cavern of Souls helps to prevent the opponent from countering key plays. This deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while quickly building a threatening board presence to secure victory.

This deck aims to aggressively disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining card advantage through efficient card draw and recursion. By utilizing powerful spells like Ancestral Recall, Time Walk, and Force of Will, as well as versatile creatures like Dreadhorde Arcanist and Snapcaster Mage, the deck can control the battlefield and apply pressure with efficient threats. With the ability to answer opposing threats, disrupt opponents' mana bases with Wasteland and Strip Mine, and consistently draw into key cards, this deck can quickly close out games in the Vintage format.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and card draw effects to generate a large amount of mana and card advantage, leading to a powerful combo finish using cards like Paradoxical Outcome. It leverages card selection and manipulation tools like Brainstorm and Gitaxian Probe to find combo pieces quickly while also running disruption like Force of Will to protect its game plan. The deck aims to play a fast and explosive game, overwhelming opponents with its powerful spells and efficient resource management.

The deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana quickly using cards like Mishra's Workshop, Ancient Tomb, and Grim Monolith. It aims to combo off with cards like Paradoxical Outcome and Mystic Forge to draw through the deck and find key pieces like Time Vault and The One Ring. Using cards like Manifold Key and Vexing Bauble to untap key artifacts and create infinite loops, the deck ultimately aims to win the game with the powerful Coveted Jewel, overwhelming the opponent with its abilities and securing victory.

This deck focuses on playing disruptive creatures and cards that hinder opponents' game plans, while also utilizing efficient mana acceleration to quickly deploy threats. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building its own board presence, pressuring the opponent and limiting their resources. The deck contains hate cards that target specific strategies commonly seen in the format, such as spell-heavy decks. By combining aggression with disruptive elements, it aims to control the game and pave the way for victory through a combination of efficient creatures and disruptive spells.

The main idea of this deck is to use powerful control elements and the Gifts Ungiven card to search for specific cards that will help to control the game and eventually win. Key cards like Force of Will, Mana Drain, and Lórien Revealed provide protection and disruption, while powerful payoffs like Underworld Breach, Brain Freeze, and Tolarian Academy can lead to a quick victory. The deck also includes a variety of powerful mana acceleration cards like Black Lotus and Moxen to help get ahead early and stay ahead in the game.

This deck focuses on assembling the combo of Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle to win the game in a single turn. The deck includes a variety of powerful card draw and search spells to find the combo pieces quickly, as well as counterspells to protect the combo from disruption. The deck is built to be fast and efficient, aiming to win the game before the opponent has a chance to respond. It relies on careful sequencing and resource management to set up the win condition successfully.

The deck revolves around using powerful artifacts and mana acceleration to quickly assemble the combo of Coveted Jewel, generating a large amount of mana and card advantage. This allows the player to control the game by casting multiple spells in a single turn and overwhelming the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Sink into Stupor to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Tezzeret, the Great Creator and Karn, the Great Creator provides additional combo pieces and utility to support the overall strategy.

The deck aims to quickly assemble the pieces needed to generate a high amount of mana and draw cards through the use of Paradoxical Outcome, allowing the player to chain spells together to either win the game on the spot or set up a winning position. It utilizes powerful artifacts and cantrips to generate mana and dig through the deck efficiently, while also having disruption and interaction to protect its combo. The inclusion of a companion in Lurrus of the Dream-Den provides additional value and flexibility for the deck's game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo of Coveted Jewel with cards like Tinker, Paradoxical Outcome, and The One Ring to generate a massive amount of mana and card advantage. It also aims to control the game using counterspells like Force of Will and disruptive artifacts like Trinisphere. Additionally, it can abuse artifacts like Voltaic Key and Manifold Key to untap powerful mana sources like Grim Monolith and the Moxen. The deck aims to win the game through overwhelming resources and powerful synergies.

This deck aims to control the game by using counterspells, removal, and disruption to prevent the opponent from executing their game plan effectively. It also includes card advantage engines like Ancestral Recall, Dig Through Time, and Treasure Cruise to maintain resources. Lurrus of the Dream-Den is utilized as a companion to provide additional value. The deck includes a combination of powerful Vintage restricted cards like Black Lotus and Time Walk, along with efficient creatures like Snapcaster Mage and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade to help close out the game. Various hate cards like Null Rod and Force of Negation are included to disrupt specific strategies.
